reserve.label: Deep in the teleport reserve
reserve.explanation: A level twenty-one priest with every class book faces three vampire bats, its mana tuned so that casting Dispel Undead leaves five points - inside the final-teleport band of every class reserve. The original applies the mana-needed-for-final-teleport penalty twice: once with the class reserve and once more with a fixed six, a subset of the first for every class. The dispel is valued at minus twenty-one thousand, one hundred twenty-seven; the correction applies the penalty once and values it at minus ten thousand six hundred twenty-seven - exactly one penalty-block lower.

clear.explanation: The same priest with twenty points to spare after the cast, outside the teleport band: neither variant applies the penalty and both value the dispel identically at minus one hundred twenty-seven, byte for byte.
